verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say it issues physical and virtual cards with configurable controls and lifecycle management, tied to account customers, on the same unified API and ledger that opens accounts. That covers the core of the story. Digital wallet support (Apple Pay or Google Pay provisioning) is not evidenced: the "wallet accounts" mentioned are FBO stored-value accounts, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: digital wallet or tokenization support, explicit confirmation the cards are debit cards, detailed API reference for card issuance and spend-control parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: Issue physical and virtual cards with configurable controls, real-time authorization capabilities, transaction data, and card lifecycle management.
Customized cards for your business, individual, or joint account customers.
They run on a unified infrastructure and native ledger, so companies can combine capabilities without stitching together
Issue cards, open accounts, move money, extend credit.
